name: CAMAROE
recent: Camaroe Berhad 于2026年11月23日发布截至2026年9月30日的季度业绩，并宣布签署一份谅解备忘录。此外，公司董事及主要股东在2026年10月初有多笔股权变动记录。
notable: 公司签署了一份谅解备忘录（MOU）。
公司公布截至2026年9月30日止季度的业绩，季度净利为210万令吉。
董事及主要股东在2026年10月有多笔股权交易记录。
risks: 根据新闻标题，公司2026财年首九个月累计净利降至53万令吉。
earnings: 最新季度（截至2026年6月30日）营收为621万令吉，环比增长23.4%，但同比下跌24.5%；净亏损35.4万令吉，净利率为-5.7%，较上一季度的-24.0%有所收窄。新闻标题显示，截至2026年9月30日止季度净利为210万令吉，但首九个月累计净利降至53万令吉。

Camaroe Reports Quarterly Profit Attributable 2.1 Million RGT
Camaroe Swings to RM2.10 Million 3Q FY2026 Profit but 9M PAT Collapses to RM0.53 Million

recent_en: Camaroe Berhad released its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026 on 23 November 2026 and announced the signing of a memorandum of understanding. In addition, there were several changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests in early October 2026.
notable_en: The company signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU).
The company announced its quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with a quarterly net profit of RM2.1 million.
There were several share transaction records by directors and substantial shareholders in October 2026.
risks_en: According to news headlines, the company's cumulative net profit for the first nine months of FY2026 fell to RM0.53 million.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM6.21 million, up 23.4% QoQ but down 24.5% YoY; net loss was RM354,000 with a net margin of -5.7%, narrowing from -24.0% in the previous quarter. News headlines indicate a quarterly net profit of RM2.1 million for the period ended 30 September 2026, but cumulative net profit for the first nine months fell to RM0.53 million.
